description:
You are a digital archivist creating an exhibit on 'The Birth of the Modern Web'. Use the Internet Archive's Wayback Machine (https://web.archive.org) to find the earliest available archived snapshot for five historically significant websites: google.com, amazon.com, wikipedia.org, youtube.com, and twitter.com.

For each website:
1. Find the earliest snapshot that successfully loads.
2. Bookmark that specific snapshot URL into a Firefox bookmark folder named 'Web Archive Research'.
3. Record the capture date and URL.

Finally, create a JSON report file at ~/Documents/web_history_report.json with the following structure for each site:
{
  "google.com": {
    "earliest_capture_date": "YYYY-MM-DD",
    "wayback_url": "https://web.archive.org/web/...",
    "description": "Brief description of the page content"
  },
  ...
}

Ensure you have entries for all 5 websites.
